audit: Every paint binds a core role Filigrane allows (text/*, border/*, surface/bg, primary/default|text, destructive/default|text, status defaults, action/*, card/*, table/*); none of the banned roles (surface/card|raised|muted|selected|inverse, tooltip/*). No base instances left except .Slot (6, Empty state media=image).

recipes.Alert: The Notice (DESIGN L349) per tone: no box, no fill, no radius. A 1px top rule (theme-only 'top-rule': border/strong; important = tomato primary/default, the Attention notice; destructive = destructive/default). One label: the 7x7 status square (the Status glyph; colour = Filigrane/Badge dot per tone, important primary/text) in a 7-wide box of the title's line height, gap 8, then the title T.strong text/fg (destructive/text, important primary/text). Body T.body text/muted on the label column. strong (derived): the base 'rule' becomes the 3px margin bar at x -8 (border/control; tomato for important; destructive/default). Action = Filigrane link (tomato text, underline).
recipes.Inline notice: The Status anatomy: no box and no rule; square, gap 8, title in the tone ink, muted description.
recipes.Toast: F.panel: surface/bg, 1px INSIDE border/strong, square, no shadow. Status square + title T.strong text/fg (error: destructive/text plus a 1px destructive/default accent rule over the top edge). Message text/muted. Timer: a 2px border/control bar (error: destructive/default) on a 1px border/strong baseline. Loading = Filigrane/Spinner.
recipes.Progress: The Dropzone upload / tab underline: a 2px bar on a 1px border/strong baseline (theme-only 'baseline'), square ends; primary text/fg, secondary text/muted, success/warning/destructive in their status colour.
recipes.Progress circular: A 1px border/strong hairline ring with a 2px square-cap arc in the same ink map.
recipes.Skeleton: Derived: line = a greeked text bar in border/subtle; block = an empty 1px border/default hairline frame (print placeholder); avatar = the hairline circle. Square, static.
recipes.Skeleton preset: Filigrane/Skeleton bones on the ground; row and head rules kept; no card fills.
recipes.Empty state: No tile, no box. Lucide glyph at 1.5 in text/muted (error destructive/text); title Newsreader Light 24/32 (the one-sentence statement); description T.body text/muted (md width 400 so the sentence sets on one line); Filigrane Solid + Outline. border=true = the Dropzone bounds: 1px border/strong rules top and bottom only.
